method.primary_rule: Tier A: both RUB and KZT plus explicit first-person offer, peer request, possession-to-need, or paired-need phrase; transaction context required; bank/exchange-office how-to filtered
method.review_sample: Fixed-seed stratified manual review: all 48 KZT_to_RUB candidates and random 52 of 75 RUB_to_KZT candidates
method.pii_handling: Transient redacted review only; no raw text or identifiers persisted

caveats: Conservative Tier A estimates a high-precision core, not recall-complete prevalence.
Completion is not observed; reply, edit, and reaction are engagement proxies only.
Direction is apparent intent, not guaranteed settlement.
Amounts and explicit rates are too sparse for GMV or market-price estimates.
